notes.title: Update ver1.03
notes.content:
Player's initial life changed from 3 to 6
Nyan power gauge increase value changed from 10 to 20
Duration of effect after acquiring an item changed from 8 to 20 seconds

Corrections

Fixed a problem in which the effect time was not extended when the same item was acquired while the item effect was in effect.

Fixed a problem in which the bell would slow down and stop when the bell was hit by a shout attack.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: A challenge from the Black Cat: a major update!
notes.content:
Difficulty level selection is now available for beginners to play

Easy mode for those who are not familiar with the game.

5 stages in total, even if the game is over, you can start over from that stage.
　


Normal mode for those who are used to playing.

If the game is over, you have to start over from stage 1!

There are 10 stages in total, and the ending is prepared when you clear the stage!
And if you clear the normal mode with a high score, something good may happen to you...


In each stage, there are obstacle blocks that interfere with the player's attacks. These obstacle blocks (special blocks) can be destroyed by shouting attacks!
Destroying them adds to your score, so aim for a high score!


New elements implemented by update!

In-game languages are now available in 13 languages!

Revision of all stages
All 5 existing stages have been reworked, so that players who have played the previous stages can still enjoy the game!

Additional Stages

The number of stages has been increased from 5 to 10!

Achievements have been added!
The number of achievements has been added along with the increase in the number of stages!

New Actions

Shout Players can destroy blocks and hit back bells with a shout attack!

Spells Players can build up their Nyan Power gauge by performing spells.

New Nyan Power

Nyan Block: For a certain period of time, a barrier appears at the bottom of the screen, making the player invincible

Mirage Nyan: For a limited time, the player's alter ego will appear and move in the same manner as the player

Nyan Blaster A huge screaming attack is generated in front of the player.
It penetrates enemies and inflicts damage.
It can also penetrate and destroy special blocks.

Nyan Power can be selected for each stage.

You can select a Nyan Power for each stage you clear!
You can choose which Nyan Power is best for which stage!



Three types of items
When you damage or defeat an enemy in each stage, an item will appear with a certain probability.
The following items will appear at random

Tule For a certain period of time, the color of the bell turns red and it can penetrate through enemies to inflict damage

Fish The speed of the bell is greatly reduced

Cat Can For a certain amount of time, the size of the bell increases by 3 times


Key Configuration

It is now possible to change the buttons to those that are easier for you to operate.

Addition of ui after clearing a stage

Added 10 patterns of cat's image after clearing a stage significantly!

notes.title: Update v1.02 Option-related Bell (ball) adjustments
notes.content:
The following items have been changed

Sensitivity and volume adjustments made in Option Mode are now saved automatically, so that the next time the game is launched, it will play with the previous settings!

The activation of special moves that consume the Nyan Power Gauge has been adjusted so that the bells (balls) do not overlap.

The basic speed of the bell (ball) has been lowered to make it easier to hit the ball back.


From the developer to everyone

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the various flaws in the initial game content.
We are very sorry that the difficulty level has been eased for those who had cleared the game with our initial adjustments!
We hope you understand that this is an update to make minor adjustments and to allow more users to enjoy the game.

We will continue to add more challenging stages, contents, and new achievements in the future, so please wait for them!

notes.title: Update Notice!　v1.01 Added features & fixes
notes.content:
The following items have been changed

The speed increase when the bell (ball) hits a wall or an enemy has been slightly reduced

The UI after clearing a stage has been changed

A confirmation screen will now appear when returning to the title & exiting the game in the option mode.

Easy mode for beginners implemented!
Mode can be selected at the start of the game!
Continuation after game over is now possible.
Even if the game is over, you can start over from that stage!
This makes it easier to clear all 5 stages!

You can still play in normal mode as before!
No need to continue! This mode is for those who want to experience the thrill of the game!

Some UI fixes The game screen is now a little easier to see.

Player movement speed on gamepad has been made a little faster.
You can change the speed to your preference by adjusting the sensitivity in the option mode.
